tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search published free and open-source AI tools on OpenFree. Filter by category/tag slug; results are paginated, up to 25 per page.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get a published OpenFree tool by its exact slug. Returns a not-found error for unpublished or unknown slugs.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List OpenFree categories with published tools, including category slugs and public usage counts.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List the 50 most-used OpenFree tags on published tools, with slugs and public usage counts. total is the number of public tags.
